purpose: Record the header-presence factor and its explicit legacy fallback for a future owner admission without creating or rewriting Fungi source.

source.signature: export function headerPresenceVerdict(headers: Readonly<Record<string, string>>, opts: HeaderPresenceOptions = {}): Verdict
source.classification: exported K3 posture factor; default is fail-closed and legacy presence-only behavior requires an explicit opt-in

helper.contract: case-insensitive lookup over Object.keys(headers); returns the first matching value or undefined

builtOracle.role: locally rebuilt differential oracle only; not Fungi or production authority

coveredBehavior: explicit fallback plus non-empty header -> ALLOW

translationAssessment.candidateShape: case-insensitive record lookup, String trimming and an explicit boolean opt-in that changes a factor from INDETERMINATE to presence-only ALLOW
translationAssessment.inputStateContract: Readonly Record<string,string> and optional readonly options; runtime proxies, getters, key order, non-string values, custom header names and mutation are not constrained by TypeScript readonly types
operationLedger: resolve opts.header or the authorization default
enumerate Object.keys(headers) and lower-case each key
read the first matching header value
if allowHeaderPresenceFallback is exactly true, return ALLOW for a non-empty value or INDETERMINATE otherwise
translationAssessment.authorityBoundary: The factor returns a Verdict; real credential verification remains upstream and the App Kernel remains the admission decision-maker. The explicit fallback is a security-sensitive legacy escape hatch.
reusableEvidence: locally rebuilt credential oracle hash is recorded
retirement register shows no Fungi replacement or execution authority
missingProofs: exact owner-authorized admission naming this symbol and scope
source-to-Fungi translation artifact and exact twin hash
differential vectors for key casing/order, duplicate matches, empty/whitespace values, custom names, aliases, proxies, getters, mutation, non-string values and thrown operations
explicit proof that the default can never authorize on presence and that the true-only legacy opt-in boundary is preserved
bounded physical record/String ABI, work limits and typed-failure profile
independent SLIDE/VOK re-admission and complete exact-head receipt
security review of the legacy presence-only branch before any consumer use

decision: This dossier is review evidence only. Keep headerPresenceVerdict BLOCKED:DOSSIER_REQUIRED and keep CANDIDATE at zero until an exact-head owner admission names a non-empty scope and the default, opt-in, input-shape and physical gates pass.
